name: Extract TeamQuickBar component from TeamView
description:
1. The user requested to wrap the recent chats list inside a collapsible container that is collapsed by default.
2. The collapsible header was configured to show a summary displaying the total chat count and the relative time of the last update.
3. We updated the `RecentChatsQuickAccess.vue` component to import and implement the generic `Collapsible` component.
4. Slots were utilized to clean up the interface and display the meta-information using Moment.js for relative duration formatting.
5. The final code adhered to all specified VueDeveloper guidelines, featuring structured SFC sections, no CSS, and zero semicolons.

messages.content: Extract the first columns to their own component

I have extracted the first column (Team icons + QuickBar) into a new Vue component named `TeamQuickBar.vue`. Here are the changes: 1. Created a new component `TeamQuickBar.vue` inside `client/src/components/teams/` containing the sidebar column, utilizing props for reactivity and emitting events for user actions. 2. Updated `TeamView.vue` to import `TeamQuickBar` and clean up its references to `MainMenu` (which is now contained and handled inside `TeamQuickBar.vue`). Here are the updated files: ```vue client/src/components/teams/TeamQuickBar.vue ``` ```vue client/src/views/TeamView.vue ```
Create a component to show the last modified chats (10-15 or scrollable) on the TeamQuickBar for quick access

An elegant component `RecentChatsQuickAccess` has been created to show the last modified chats on the `TeamQuickBar` sidebar. Following the strict **VueDeveloper** profile, both components are structured using the double script blocks format with ` ``` --- ### 2. Update the `TeamQuickBar.vue` Component Integrate the `RecentChatsQuickAccess` component directly into the `TeamQuickBar` layout. The component structure has also been modernized to follow your strict double script pattern. ```vue client/src/components/teams/TeamQuickBar.vue ```
Extract channels bar to it's own component

Here is the extracted Channels Bar component and the refactored `TeamView.vue`. We have: 1. Created a new component `TeamChannelsBar.vue` which encapsulates the channels sidebar, search, category management, direct messages, and user status bar. 2. Kept the script setup section containing only imports. 3. Removed any semicolons (`;`) as per the project profile guidelines. 4. Used TailwindCSS classes without external CSS. ### 1. Create the new extracted channels bar component ```vue client/src/components/teams/TeamChannelsBar.vue ``` ### 2. Update `TeamView.vue` to use the new `TeamChannelsBar` component ```vue client/src/views/TeamView.vue ```

We need a new TeamBar to group channels bar and recent chat and probably other components in the future, it should be scrollable. First version will have Channel and RecenChats.
